items.source: The observant reader will notice that the sole attribute on the <util:properties/> element matches the PropertiesLoaderSupport.setLocation(org.springframework.core.io.Resource) method name on the PropertiesFactoryBean (the general usage thus illustrated holds true for any number of attributes). All that the PropertiesBeanDefinitionParser needs actually do is supply an implementation of the AbstractSingleBeanDefinitionParser.getBeanClass(org.w3c.dom.Element) method to return the PropertiesFactoryBean type.
items.translation: 细心的读者会注意到，`` 元素上的唯一属性与 `PropertiesLoaderSupport.setLocation(org.springframework.core.io.Resource)` 方法名匹配（此处所演示的一般用法对任意数量的属性均适用）。`PropertiesBeanDefinitionParser` 实际上只需提供一个 `AbstractSingleBeanDefinitionParser.getBeanClass(org.w3c.dom.Element)` 方法的实现，以返回 `PropertiesFactoryBean` 类型。

items.source: Please note that the AbstractSimpleBeanDefinitionParser is limited to populating the created bean definition with property values. if you want to parse constructor arguments and nested elements from the supplied XML element, then you will have to implement the postProcess(org.springframework.beans.factory.support.BeanDefinitionBuilder, org.w3c.dom.Element) method and do such parsing yourself, or (more likely) subclass the AbstractSingleBeanDefinitionParser or AbstractBeanDefinitionParser classes directly.
items.translation: 请注意，`AbstractSimpleBeanDefinitionParser` 仅限于为创建的 Bean 定义填充属性值。如果您想从提供的 XML 元素中解析构造函数参数和嵌套元素，则必须实现postProcess(org.springframework.beans.factory.support.BeanDefinitionBuilder, org.w3c.dom.Element)方法并自行执行此类解析，或者（更有可能的情况）直接继承AbstractSingleBeanDefinitionParser或AbstractBeanDefinitionParser类。

items.source: Extend this parser class when you want to create a single bean definition from a relatively simple custom XML element. The resulting BeanDefinition will be automatically registered with the relevant BeanDefinitionRegistry.
items.translation: 在需要从一个相对简单的自定义 XML 元素创建单个 bean 定义时，扩展此解析器类。生成的 BeanDefinition 将自动注册到相关的 BeanDefinitionRegistry。

items.source: The extractPropertyName(String) method is used to reconcile the name of an attribute with the name of a JavaBean property.
items.translation: `extractPropertyName(String)` 方法用于协调属性名称与 JavaBean 属性名称。

items.source: The default implementation uses the Conventions.attributeNameToPropertyName(String) method to perform the extraction.
items.translation: 默认实现使用 Conventions.attributeNameToPropertyName(String) 方法执行提取。

items.source: The name returned must obey the standard JavaBean property name conventions. For example for a class with a setter method 'setBingoHallFavourite(String)', the name returned had better be 'bingoHallFavourite' (with that exact casing).
items.translation: 返回的名称必须遵循标准的 JavaBean 属性命名约定。例如，对于具有 setter 方法`setBingoHallFavourite(String)`的类，返回的名称最好是'bingoHallFavourite'（使用完全相同的拼写）。
